grains.RAW.ZONES: one row per delivery zone (one service in one Philippine city)
grains.RAW.ZONE_DAILY: one row per zone per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.RIDER_DOCUMENTS: one row per zone (rider compliance document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.disruption_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(delivery disruption in the zone in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide failed-delivery FORECAST; hub-to-door time ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PLAYBOOK_SEARCH over synthetic delivery disruption SOPs (one per service and disruption cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.DELIVERY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.DELIVERY_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, zone, disruption-cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (zones, daily failed deliveries, disruption hours by zone, delivery-disruption risk, delivery-attempt events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_DELIVERIES
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_DELIVERY_ALERT logs new FAILED attempts to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
